office: the Passport Unit of the Immigration Division (Ministry of Commerce, Industry, Labour and Immigration), in person in the Solomon Islands
note: The ordinary passport's fee under Legal Notice No. 27 of 13 March 2018, in force from 19 April 2018: $1,000.00 for a new or renewed passport, plus a fast processing fee of $300.00 for processing within 5 working days (summed here). A lost or damaged passport costs $1,300.00 (not modelled). The Ministry's pages write the fee without a currency sign beyond $; the currency of the Solomon Islands is the dollar (SBD). Applications must be made in person in the Solomon Islands, so no route abroad is modelled; Travel Identity Documents for citizens abroad who lost their passport are not modelled.

sources.title: Immigration Division, Public Notice of 19 March 2018 on new passport application fees (linked from the Ministry's Fees and Penalties page as "Passport Fees")
sources.said: PURSUANT TO LEGAL NOTICE NO. 27 DATED 13TH MARCH 2018, THE IMMIGRATION DIVISION WILL ENFORCE THE FOLLOWING NEW PASSPORT APPLICATION FEES AS OF 19TH APRIL 2018. ... NEW PASSPORT $1,000.00 ... RENEWED PASSPORT $1,000.00 ... IF AN APPLICANT WISHES TO HAVE HIS/HER PASSPORT PROCESSED WITHIN 5 WORKING DAYS, A FAST PROCESSING FEE OF $300.00 WILL BE CHARGED.

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry, Labour and Immigration, Immigration (frequent questions)
sources.said: Ordinary passport valid for 10 years for general citizens for travel abroad. ($1000.00) ... Collect your passport after 14 working days (or sooner for express fees)
